notes.title: New Title early access
notes.notes:
Dear, Everyone:
     
        Thanks for your long time support. Our new game "Palace Of The Azure Dragon" will release early access in 2 days. I would like to offer you all a chance to try our new game for free. 

        Just send your steam account name to our email address info@genegamescorp.com, we will give you some  CD keys. 

       Good Luck guys!!!

Best Regards,

GeneGames Co.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.5 Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Time for the first hotfix of 2017.   Thanks to your feedback, we've put together some fixes.

Patch Notes for Hotfix 1.0.5 (Released Feb 9):
•	Fixed the tutorial hint.
•	Fixed several English grammatical mistakes.
